Hi Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

- Key goals you mentioned: reduce inference latency for triage models, cut per-token spend with caching/batching, and validate accuracy on your top-5 prompt set.
- Success criteria we talked about: 95th percentile latency < 120ms for inference path, cost <= $0.002/token for production traffic, and F1 >= 0.88 on the curated prompt set.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) Technical deep dive / demo (45–60m): we'll walk through a short live demo of the runtime, KV/prefix caching, and quantization tradeoffs. Ben will cover architecture and integration checklist.
2) Pilot plan kickoff (60m): review mutual action plan, trial timeline (4 weeks), required data/sample prompts, and success metrics. Marissa will lead the pilot success criteria and evaluation plan.

I pulled a few windows on Wed/Thu next week — please pick any that work or propose others:
- Wed 7/22: 10:00–11:00 PT or 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 7/23: 09:00–10:00 PT or 16:00–17:00 PT

Attached a short demo agenda + a one-page mutual action plan draft. If you want, we can split the session: 30m demo + 30m pilot kickoff.

Also tagging procurement for any early questions about PO/standard terms (see CC).

Thanks — looking forward to locking a slot.

— Karthik
